alignments.note: Supplied indefinite article joins the noun under rule 15.
Superscription lamed rendered *of*; the preposition takes the word written for it (rule 11). Margin *for the thank-offering* read and set aside (rule 38).
Light verb plus complement (rule 44); head on the complement noun *noise*. Competing head *joyful*, which carries the joy sense of the lexeme; *noise* chosen as the complement's own head noun.
ASV writes no *the* (*all ye lands*); article unrepresented under rule 29. Margin *Hebrew all the earth* read and set aside (rule 38).
Vocative takes the supplied *ye* into its own unit (rule 36).

review_notes: Vocative *all ye lands*: *ye* placed on the noun under rule 36, article unrepresented.

alignments.note: Object marker with bare English object (rule 16).
ASV spends a word on each morpheme of לִפְנֵי (*before* ... *presence*), so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 splits them; the preposition takes *before*.
פָּנֶה rendered by its own word *presence*; see s007.

review_notes: לְפָנָיו split into *before* / *presence* / *his* because the ASV writes a word for each morpheme (rule 30 condition unmet).

alignments.note: Imperative with its supplied subject pronoun (rule 17).
Explicit pronoun takes only its own *he*; copula goes to the predicate (rule 20).
Construction-supplied copula joins the nominal predicate (rule 20).
Cleft dummy and copula answer to no morpheme; the clause's predication is carried by the written verb עָשָׂה (rule 20 cleft paragraph).

Explicit subject pronoun realized as *he* and, in the ASV's cleft, by the relative *that* pointing at it (rule 20: an explicit pronoun takes a *that* the ASV writes for it; rule 18). Competing reading leaves *that* as a separate `added` cleft relative under rule 55.
Variant WLC.PSA.100.3.v001 selected r00-base (וְלוֹ); the printed *and we are his* follows it. Margin *and not we ourselves* read and set aside (rule 38).

Possessive לְ is itself the verbless clause's predicate and the ASV writes its relation inside the possessive *his* (rule 49 fused-genitive closing paragraph, with rule 40's boundary); the copula joins the fused unit. Head on the suffix, which carries the referent (rule 23). Competing reading: copula *are* to the לְ alone under rule 49's first sentence and *his* to the suffix.
Explicit pronoun resumed by the ASV as the subject of the following subjectless verbless clause (*We are his people*); both occurrences belong to the one אֲנַחְנוּ (rule 25), headed on the first.
Copula joins the nominal predicate (rule 20).
Supplied *the* on the construct noun (rule 29).
Rectum takes *of* (rule 19); discontinuous around the suffix's *his*.

review_notes: Cleft *It is he that hath made us*: *It is* added; *he ... that* given to the explicit הוּא per rule 20's cleft paragraph.
וְלוֹ אֲנַחְנוּ: לְ+suffix fused as *are his* (rule 49 fused genitive); the second *We* is the resumed אֲנַחְנוּ under rule 25.
Variant v001 selected base reading; ASV margin reports the other reading.

variant_decisions.evidence: ASV 100:3 'and we are his' renders the qere וְלוֹ ('and his'); the textual_variant note 'Another reading is, and not we ourselves' explicitly identifies the ketiv ולא as the alternative not adopted in the text.

alignments.note: Imperative בֹּאוּ → Enter (rule 17). The supplied into is read as the bare directional accusative's own function word under rule 33 and placed on the noun, not here; see the gates unit.

שְׁעָרָיו stands bare after בּוֹא as an accusative of direction; the supplied into states that case-function and belongs to the noun under rule 33 (as 'to your mountain'), headed on gates. Competing reading: rule 44's supplied-preposition clause, treating the gates as the verb's direct object and giving into to בּוֹא; rejected because the noun is an adverbial accusative of place, and the parallel colon writes its own into for a noun with no verb at all.
3ms suffix → his (rule 18).
בְּ → with (rule 11).
תּוֹדָה → thanksgiving. Margin 'Or, a thank-offering' read and set aside under rule 38.
The second colon is asyndetic in the Hebrew; no waw stands to license And, so it is added under rule 14's closing sentences.
חֲצֵרֹתָיו is a bare directional accusative in a colon whose verb is gapped; the supplied into belongs to the noun under rule 33 on the same terms as the gates unit, headed on courts.
3ms suffix → his (rule 18).
בְּ → with (rule 11).
תְּהִלָּה → praise.
הוֹדוּ → Give thanks, light verb plus complement headed on thanks (rule 44).
לְ → unto (rule 11).
3ms suffix → him (rule 18).
בָּרֲכוּ is juxtaposed with no waw; the coordinating and answers to no morpheme and is added under rule 14. Separate from the earlier And, since rendered material stands between them (rule 2).
Imperative בָּרֲכוּ → bless (rule 17).
שֵׁם → name; construct with suffix rectum, the suffix taking the possessive under rule 18.
3ms suffix → his (rule 18).

review_notes: Both supplied 'into's placed on the bare directional nouns under rule 33 rather than on בּוֹא under rule 44; the gapped second colon makes the noun-based reading the consistent one. Both connectives (And, and) are added: the Hebrew is asyndetic throughout.
ASV margin 'Or, a thank-offering' read and set aside (rule 38).

alignments.note: Adjectival predicate takes the construction-supplied copula (rule 20).

Prepositional predicate of a verbless clause; *endureth* is the construction's continuance copula and joins the preposition (rule 20's own לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ example; rule 49). Head on the relational word *for*.

Distributive repetition דֹּר וָדֹר rendered once with a supplied quantifier; the first occurrence takes the noun and its determiner (rule 22 distributive paragraph, rule 15). Competing reading fuses all three morphemes under rule 30; rejected because *generations* is spent on this noun in particular.
Waw of the distributive repetition; no connective written (rules 14, 22).
Repeated occurrence rendered once (rule 22).
Gapped copula not written by the ASV; noun keeps only its own word.

review_notes: *endureth for* placed on the predicate לְ per rule 20/49.
דֹּר וָדֹר → *all generations*: first דֹּר rendered, waw and second דֹּר unrepresented.
